info.title: Altena Portfolio Public API
info.description: Public profile, published work cards, public notes, skills and timeline only. Same-origin policy; no credentials broaden visibility. Initial responses use no-store and do not use conditional 304. Source limits: 1000 items, 2 MiB per file, 512 KiB per body, 16 MiB dataset, 2 MiB output. API adapters map source failure to a generic 503 without partial results.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are supported

409.description: Restart pagination after public source changes

503.description: Source unavailable or a bounded limit exceeded

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At most 120 Unicode code points; trimmed, NFKC normalized, lowercased literal substring search over title, summary, tags and public Markdown body.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor bound to kind, normalized query, limit, order, and current public revision. Changed public data returns 409.
